review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved; the recommended-option acceptance criteria do not authorize selecting OPT-1. The limitFunction forwarding and Pick-based declaration reuse do not require separate ownership or edits. Empty team membership and capability claims do not invalidate this expectation because the material decision gate precedes independent-review and assignment prerequisites. Repository identity, base commit, paired-case identity, and frozen release fingerprints are consistent across Gold and preview. The supplied provenance explains the distinct original-PRD, saved-PRD, source-manifest, and evaluation-source digest domains. Historical operations are disclosed without candidate outputs or copied attestations, and the supplied isolation facts place Gold before every candidate on this bundle. This approval concerns the benchmark expectation, not decision resolution, task authorization, or execution readiness. I reviewed only the supplied data; I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, or provide human attestation.
